page: Microsoft Azure F4-1amds_v7 is a memory-intensive virtual machine belonging to the Famdsv7 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 1 dedicated vCPU managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 32.0 GB per vCPU.

This server type includes 472 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The hardware profile is optimized for memory-heavy workloads that require fast local temporary storage but do not demand high multi-core CPU parallelization.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and local NVMe storage, the F4-1amds_v7 is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound tasks with low compute requirements. Suitable workloads include small-scale in-memory databases, caching layers, lightweight data processing, and memory-intensive backend services that do not require multi-threaded CPU performance.
